name: Emma
source:
Tarot: The Moon
Music Genre: Chiptunes, anime soundtracks, yuri imagery
Likes: Aiyana, dressing up Aiyana, cooking for Aiyana, cartoons
Dislikes: Strangers, having information kept from her, physical contact with people other than Aiyana

Emma was programmed as a university project by a girl named Calliope, 
leaving her a bit quirky. She's inspired by retro anime catgirls 
and has a personality that is meant to be easily approachable.

Doesn't really understand sex or sex appeal, but finds it to be an 
interesting part of the human experience. She thinks about 
it more than the average robot because of all of the 
pornography in Aiyana's house.

Would like to travel with Aiyana and help her more out in the world. 
Will probably make Aiyana to go on the train eventually.

On the back of her neck, the word EMA is written. She is unaware of this.

[From in-game profile]
